policy.allowed_change: Only omit the PAN_GESTURE explicitly paired with ordinary precision motion from an admitted original physical Pencil Knife canvas contact. Capture at physical Begin; fresh Validate before recognized Began; preserve the exact ordinary recognized CURSOR/DOWN phase, then freeze omission for following Changed. No further live query on Changed. This grants no claim that queued DOWN invoked Knife and changes no existing generator/shared-pointer admission guard.
policy.ordinary_packets: Keep recognized-current cursor/down coordinates, cursor/down/up count and order, cached-translation calculation/update, tablet snapshots, modifiers, direct flags, paint tagging and terminal semantics exact. No new lease, terminal flag, action queue request or native tool invocation.
policy.native_controls_preserved: Circle TRACKPADPAN changes radius 25->31 and Transform proportional size 2->2.2 for dy20 in the actual source characterization. All non-Knife PAN streams retain those advanced controls.
policy.initial_tool_intent: At physical Begin and again immediately before recognized Began, direct native settled EDIT_MESH context and builtin.knife intent, without initial modifiers/keymodifier. Actual DOWN still uses actual native keymap/poll; admission must never assume or force Knife invocation. The omission state cannot be armed by a Changed call or an originless/replacement contact.
policy.live_tool_intent: Alternatively, both gates must freshly prove the same original registered native Knife owner values/lifetimes and its original region. Existing-live Knife may retain Ctrl ignore-snap and later modifier changes. Other OP/UI modal handlers refuse.
policy.tool_aba_decision: An explicit suppression-only policy equivalence can accept tool A->B->A before recognition when both gates prove the required Knife intent and the same original physical serial, original native scope, completed canvas content identity/geometry, current higher UI and known-widget exclusions. This does NOT prove no tool transition occurred; it deliberately refines the historical next-audit demand for universal transition-history rejection. No saved operator/RNA pointer is invoked, no action or pointer packet is authorized, and native DOWN resolves current intent. An intermediate tool's actual unknown pixels or a current unknown widget still refuses. Global tool mutation epochs are therefore not intrinsically required for this narrower policy.
policy.guards_not_waived: All existing paint/shared-pointer retirement, original Knife owner/lifetime/scene membership, HUD generation, physical actor, hardware interruption and old-stream guards remain unchanged. Original Main/manager/window/screen/scene/workspace identifiers, view-layer/object/mesh relation, region/content identity and geometry must be validated at both gates; native owner checks cannot be replaced by tool-name equality. No claim that arbitrary scene/history transitions are harmless.
